title: Sharing foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing is now generally available
body: Sharing and reading foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing is now generally available. Providers can share Iceberg tables federated from foreign Iceberg catalogs using Lakehouse Federation, including to recipients using external Iceberg clients. See [Add foreign Iceberg tables to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#foreign-iceberg) for providers and [Read data in a shared foreign Iceberg table](/aws/en/opensharing/read-data-databricks#foreign-ice-tables) for recipients.
